disposition_reason: The registration scopes recorded offline decoding, which is ordered, but its exact source-paper offline baseline and original folds/session mapping are unrecovered. The published online fine-tuned human-control headline is incompatible with replay scoring and cannot be the offline victory threshold.

source_paper.title: EEG-based brain-computer interface enables real-time robotic hand control at individual finger level

evidence.locator: Figure 2A; Methods: Offline analysis and Online decoding; Discussion
evidence.supports: Offline versus online comparisons, selected participant cohort and online headline result.
Original source-folder selection, trial-first 80/20 validation, EEG preprocessing and native EEGNet training/fine-tuning route.
Subject/session, MI/ME, two-/three-class separation and window/resampling/filter parameters.

evidence.locator: Implemented scope and prospective decisions; Evidence and retained limits
evidence.supports: The local same-Finetune-trial spectral replay differs from the original online Base-versus-Finetune human-adapting design; participant-macro hard voting and bootstrap policies are prospective construction choices.

target.description: Classify imagined or executed thumb/index/pinky activity in the source-defined binary and ternary conditions. Retrospective recorded decoding and online closed-loop control remain distinct targets.

dataset.description: Published Finger-BCI Figshare data are identified; complete source-member-to-MAT-to-evaluation provenance and original offline analysis membership remain unqualified.

cohort.description: The final source cohort is 21 selected BCI responders, not all 49 recruits. Preserve the original MI/ME and binary/ternary participant/session scope.

split.description: Paper offline analyses include five-fold decoding and retrospective session-model comparisons. Native training uses trial-first 80/20 validation; these are distinct splits. Exact figure-specific folds and source-session mappings remain unbound.

inputs.description: 128-channel EEG and permitted training/calibration labels, with source task condition. Evaluation targets and recorded online predictions/probabilities are excluded from candidate input.

preprocessing.description: Native code uses CAR, 1-second windows at 128-sample stride from 1024 Hz, resampling to 100 Hz, causal fourth-order 4–40 Hz Butterworth filtering and per-window channel z-scoring. Binary fine-tuning draws both Base class folders before retaining thumb/pinky.

metric.description: Source offline classification accuracy needs its figure-specific window/trial rule recovered. Online cumulative finger decisions and a local hard-vote replay score are not interchangeable.

aggregation.description: Original fold/session/participant weighting for the chosen offline panel is not yet joined to published numbers; the local participant-macro paired replay aggregation is prospective.

published_baseline.description: The published 80.56% binary MI and 60.61% ternary MI headline values concern online fine-tuned control. They are not an offline replay baseline. No exact matching numeric source offline comparator is recovered; value is null.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: No qualified rerun of the original author comparison is established. Public source and construction code are a recovery route, not a measured comparator.

minimum_effect.rationale: A meaningful effect must be justified for this original endpoint after recovering its numerical baseline and measurement variability; no generic percentage or significance-only victory is admitted.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare paired uncertainty for the complete original panel after recovering source-level dependence and replication; no final decision rule is yet qualified.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Participants, preserving all dependent runs, sessions and overlapping windows within participant; exact original repeated-measures comparison still requires recovery.
uncertainty.rationale: Changing the evaluation partition to simplify inference would define a separate extension.

paper_win_requires: Recover a complete original offline paper panel, exact folds/session membership, decision rule and numeric EEGNet baseline before enabling same-task comparison.
Match imagery/execution, class roster, complete original participants, chronological training and source-prescribed calibration inputs; keep every trial’s overlapping windows together.
Compare against the source EEGNet training and fine-tuning procedure under identical allowed input and tuning budgets; nearest-centroid spectral references are calibration only.
Do not call improved replay accuracy a gain over the online human-adapting Base-versus-Finetune experiment.
Resolve S07 session-5 missing events without silently shrinking the original panel; predeclare task-specific effect and participant-level uncertainty. New participant-transfer splits are extensions.

current_sota.description: Surpassing this source paper is distinct from current SOTA; no contemporary competitor survey or SOTA result is asserted.

episode.improvement_loop: After recovering the chosen original offline figure panel, iterate on its permitted participant/session training data and trial-grouped validation feedback. Respect MI/ME and binary/ternary source routes, including the two Base-folder route for binary fine-tuning. Keep overlapping windows within their original trial and log any preprocessing, EEGNet or calibration change without using final-session labels.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze the exact offline figure estimand, original participant/session/run roster and exclusions, source MAT conversion, original folds, source-folder calibration access, EEG preprocessing, window-to-trial rule, EEGNet selection/fine-tuning recipe, aggregation and budgets before final scoring. Resolve missing S07 events before freezing the denominator.
episode.final_evaluation: Evaluate the frozen candidate and recovered native EEGNet baseline on the same complete original offline panel, retaining every condition and participant result. A same-Finetune-trial replay gain, participant-transfer split or changed calibration allowance is a separate extension. No offline output can establish improvement over the online human-control headline.
episode.baseline_policy: Use the figure-matched original offline EEGNet result and qualified rerun as distinct comparators. Keep the online binary/ternary headline scores, local nearest-centroid spectral reference, calibration-augmented replay reference and prospective participant-macro/bootstrap diagnostics separately labeled; none substitutes for the missing original offline baseline.

blocking_issues: Exact original offline panel, numeric score, decision rule and folds/session aggregation are unresolved.
Complete source-MAT conversion and cohort membership remain unqualified, including S07 missing-event handling.
Native EEGNet environment, checkpoints, validation selection and first-four-layer fine-tuning freeze have no qualified rerun.
Local same-Finetune-trial spectral comparison changes the original human-adapting Base/Finetune design.
No matched author baseline, fixed access/resource budget or justified effect and uncertainty rule.

legacy.notes: The initial evaluator’s spectral nearest-centroid and calibration-augmented references use a prospective paired replay protocol. Hard voting, participant means, Brier diagnostics and construction bootstrap intervals cannot certify an original-paper improvement; historical materials remain intact.
